context_for_next_testing_agent: AlterEcho iteration_4 successfully implements Audio Mode toggle feature. NEW FEATURE: Audio Mode card with two buttons (Same Room / Headphone) positioned below status row. Same Room mode (default) enables echo cancellation to prevent speaker-to-mic feedback when using mic and speaker in same room. Headphone mode disables echo cancellation for ultra-low latency when using headphones (no feedback risk). Mode info text changes dynamically: 'Echo cancellation active — prevents speaker-to-mic feedback' (room) vs 'Echo cancellation off — use headphones to avoid feedback loop' (headphone). Default gain and volume reduced from 100% to 70% for better initial experience. Hot-swap functionality allows switching modes while audio is active. All existing features continue to work: 10 voice profiles, 3 effect buttons, echo toggle with 4 levels, sliders, toggles, device detection. App URL: https://audio-engine-preview.preview.emergentagent.com
